errors.text_span: Пяттият сектор е синьо-сив, с етикет „Под 1 година“ и приблизителен процент 13,6%.
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates the existence of a fifth sector. While the category 'Под 1 година' (Under 1 year) is present in the legend, it has a value of 0% and therefore does not have a corresponding slice in the pie chart.

In the sentence describing the non-existent fifth sector, the description incorrectly assigns it a value of 13.6%. This percentage actually belongs to the category 'Над 1 до 5 години' (Over 1 to 5 years). The correct value for 'Под 1 година' is 0%.
The description invents the color 'синьо-сив' (blue-grey) for the hallucinated fifth sector. The legend entry for this category ('Под 1 година') is marked with a blue dot.
The description includes the non-existent 'синьо-сивия' (blue-grey) sector in its summary of sectors arranged in descending order of size.
